products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by first mortgages on one to four family residences and home equity lines of credit, primarily in the local market area. Loans are processed at branch offices or online, underwritten to internal standards, and may be held or sold into the secondary market. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person or digital application processing.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by income-producing commercial properties, including retail and multifamily, as well as commercial construction loans. Involves in-person underwriting, property appraisals, and ongoing monitoring. Requires significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit to small businesses for working capital needs, secured by business assets such as accounts receivable, inventory, and equipment. Involves in-person relationship management, financial analysis, and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination of home improvement loans, unsecured personal loans, and other consumer loans to individuals. Delivered through branch offices and subject to underwriting and regulatory standards. Requires in-person or digital application processing.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including savings, checking, money market, and certificates of deposit. Delivered through branch network and digital channels, supported by regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment in and management of securities portfolios, including mortgage-backed securities, U.S. Treasury and agency obligations, and municipal bonds. Primarily for balance sheet management and liquidity, not direct sales to customers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, multi-family real estate loans, operating and working capital loans, equipment financing, business lines of credit, term loans, construction loans, and SBA-guaranteed loans. These are typically secured by business assets and may involve personal guarantees.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Offers loans to agricultural producers and agribusinesses, including seasonal operating loans, equipment and machinery financing, breeding stock acquisition, and long-term real estate loans. These are secured by crops, livestock, equipment, or real estate and tailored to the agricultural cycle.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides loans for the purchase, refinancing, and improvement of 1-4 family residential properties, including first mortgages, home equity term loans, and home equity lines of credit. Most originated mortgages are sold into the secondary market.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides loans to individuals for personal, family, or household purposes, including auto loans, personal loans, lines of credit, and loans for boats and recreational vehicles. These loans may be secured or unsecured.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a variety of deposit accounts to individuals, businesses, and public entities, including checking, savings, money market, time deposits, and retirement accounts (IRAs). These services are delivered through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides wealth management, trust administration, estate administration, conservatorships, agency accounts, farm management, investment, and custodial services to individuals, businesses, and non-profits. Requires specialized staff and regulatory trust powers.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Offers business customers services such as cash management, merchant credit card processing, wire transfers, direct deposit, and automated/video teller machine access. These services support business operations and liquidity management.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Invests in and manages portfolios of U.S. Government securities, agency securities, municipal bonds, and corporate debt securities. Income is generated from interest and gains on these investments.

products.name: Diagnostic Imaging Services
products.description: Provision of a full range of diagnostic and screening imaging services, including advanced modalities (MRI, CT, PET) and routine modalities (x-ray, ultrasound, mammography), delivered through a network of outpatient imaging centers using physical equipment, skilled technologists, and subspecialized radiologists.

products.name: Teleradiology Services
products.description: Remote interpretation of radiographic images by subspecialized radiologists using a proprietary teleradiology platform (Connexia), leveraging digital transmission and advanced workflow software to provide flexible, scalable radiology reads across the network.

products.name: Imaging Center Management Services (Joint Ventures)
products.description: Management and administrative services provided to joint venture imaging centers with health system partners, including operational expertise, staffing, equipment procurement, and expansion support, delivered through contractual and equity-based arrangements.

products.name: Custom Manufacturing Marketplace Services
products.description: A digital, AI-powered online marketplace connecting buyers with suppliers for custom manufacturing services across a wide range of processes (e.g., CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet forming, die casting, tube cutting/bending, urethane casting, extrusion, additive manufacturing). The platform provides instant quoting, design-for-manufacturing insights, supplier matching, and order fulfillment, leveraging a global supplier network. Delivery is fully digital, with physical manufacturing performed by third-party suppliers.

products.name: Thomasnet Industrial Sourcing and Advertising Services
products.description: A digital platform offering industrial buyers access to a comprehensive supplier database and providing suppliers with digital marketing, advertising, and lead generation services. Includes SEO, content creation, data-driven advertising, analytics, and performance-based listings. Delivered as a SaaS and digital advertising solution.

products.name: Supplier Financial Services
products.description: Financial products for manufacturing suppliers, including accelerated payouts (Instant Pay) and digital invoicing, designed to improve supplier cash flow and operational efficiency. Delivered digitally through the Xometry platform and Workcenter system.

products.name: Workcenter Manufacturing Execution Software
products.description: A cloud-based manufacturing execution system (MES) and partner operating system for suppliers, providing workflow management, job tracking, and operational tools. Delivered as SaaS via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Wholesale Water and Wastewater Services
products.description: Provision of wholesale water and wastewater services, including water withdrawal, treatment, storage, distribution, and wastewater collection and treatment, primarily to local governmental entities, residential, commercial, and industrial customers in the Denver, Colorado area. Services are delivered via owned and operated infrastructure such as wells, pipelines, reservoirs, and treatment facilities.

products.name: Land Development (Finished Lot Sales)
products.description: Development of raw land into master planned communities, including the construction of infrastructure (roads, utilities, parks, open spaces) and sale of finished lots to homebuilders for residential, commercial, retail, and light industrial uses. Delivery involves physical construction and coordination with governmental entities for public improvements.

products.name: Single-Family Home Rentals
products.description: Development and leasing of single-family detached homes and townhomes for rent, primarily within the Sky Ranch community. Homes are constructed by contracted homebuilders and rented out under annual lease agreements, providing recurring rental income.

products.name: Water Supply for Industrial Oil and Gas Operations
products.description: Provision of raw water for industrial customers, particularly oil and gas operators performing hydraulic fracturing. Water is delivered via bulk meters or fill stations, with fees based on metered gallons delivered.

products.name: Consulting and Contract Operations Services
products.description: Provision of consulting and contract operation services to municipalities and area water providers, including design, construction, operation, and maintenance of water and wastewater systems. Services are typically billed monthly.

products.name: Oil and Gas Mineral Leasing and Royalties
products.description: Leasing of oil and gas mineral rights and collection of royalties from production on owned land, such as Sky Ranch. Revenue is generated from upfront lease payments and ongoing royalties from oil and gas sales.

products.name: MRO Product Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a wide range of maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and equipment, including rotating equipment, bearings, power transmission, industrial supplies, metal working, and safety products, sourced from OEMs and stocked in service centers for same-day delivery to industrial customers. This is a physical distribution business requiring warehousing, logistics, and technical sales expertise.

products.name: Custom Pump Packages and Pump Remanufacturing
products.description: Design, engineering, fabrication, and delivery of integrated custom pump skid packages, remanufactured pumps, and branded private label pumps to customer specifications, primarily for capital equipment needs in water, wastewater, and industrial markets. This involves in-house engineering, project management, and manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Supply Chain Services for MRO Products
products.description: Provision of fully outsourced supply chain management services for MRO products, including procurement, inventory optimization, storeroom management, transaction consolidation, vendor oversight, and productivity improvement, often delivered on-site at customer locations under long-term contracts. This is a service business leveraging proprietary programs and consultative expertise.

products.name: Safety Services
products.description: Provision of safety-related services including field safety supervision, hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas protection, specialized and standby fire protection, medic services, safety audits, instrument repair and calibration, training, monitoring, equipment rental, and consulting. These services are delivered both in-house and in the field, often as part of broader MRO or safety product offerings.

products.name: Residential and Small Business Broadband Internet Services
products.description: High-speed broadband internet services delivered over fiber and copper networks to residential and small business customers, including multi-gigabit speeds, advanced Wi-Fi, and bundled wireless options. Requires physical network infrastructure and in-person installation.

products.name: Residential and Small Business Voice Services
products.description: Traditional landline and digital voice services for residential and small business customers, delivered over fiber and copper networks, with features such as call management and emergency access. Requires regulated infrastructure and network operations.

products.name: Value-Added Residential Services (Wi-Fi Equipment, Security, Support, Streaming)
products.description: Add-on services for residential customers including advanced Wi-Fi gateways and mesh extenders, internet security suites, premium technical support, and live television/streaming video bundles. Delivered via leased equipment, digital platforms, and partnerships.

products.name: Enterprise Managed Network and Security Services
products.description: Platform-led managed services for enterprises, including SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, managed network security, and LAN services. Delivered through a combination of proprietary software, on-net fiber, and partner access, with 24/7 service assurance and customer portals. Requires digital infrastructure and expert human labor.

products.name: Enterprise Cloud Connectivity and Collaboration Services
products.description: Cloud-optimized connectivity and collaboration solutions for enterprises, including high-speed internet, Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS), and Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS). Delivered via cloud platforms, proprietary portals, and managed network infrastructure.

products.name: Fiber-Based Enterprise Internet and Networking Services
products.description: Fiber-based internet connectivity, managed networking, and advanced networking products (Ethernet, SD-WAN) for enterprise customers, supporting secure, scalable, and resilient business operations. Delivered over nationwide fiber infrastructure with tailored solutions.

products.name: Fiber-Based Business Voice Services
products.description: Business voice solutions integrated with fiber connectivity, including hosted and cloud-enabled voice platforms for enterprise communications. Delivered over fiber infrastructure with managed support.

products.name: E-Rate and Community Institution Connectivity Services
products.description: Affordable, scalable fiber and network services for educational and community institutions eligible under federal E-Rate programs, supporting connectivity needs under regulated frameworks. Delivered via fiber infrastructure and subject to federal program requirements.

products.name: Colocation and Data Center Services
products.description: Secure colocation solutions providing access to on-net fiber points of presence, enabling customers to connect their infrastructure within Uniti-connected facilities. Includes space, power, and technical support for enterprise and wholesale customers. Requires physical facilities and operational teams.

products.name: Wholesale Fiber Bandwidth and Transport Services
products.description: High-capacity bandwidth and transport services for wholesale customers, including telecom companies, hyperscalers, content providers, and carriers. Includes optical wave services (10-400 Gbps), Ethernet, internet, dark fiber, and fiber-to-the-tower connections, delivered via long-haul and metro fiber networks under multi-year contracts.

products.name: Casino Gaming Services
products.description: Operation of casino gaming facilities offering slot machines, table games, video poker, and sports wagering, primarily at large resort properties and smaller local casinos. These services require significant physical infrastructure, regulatory licensing, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Accommodations
products.description: Provision of hotel rooms and suites at major casino resort properties, including luxury and standard accommodations. Delivery requires physical real estate, hospitality staff, and regulated operations.

products.name: Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Operation of full-service restaurants, quick-serve outlets, bars, lounges, and food halls within casino and resort properties. This business line is delivered through in-person dining and beverage service, requiring culinary and hospitality staff.

products.name: Entertainment and Event Services
products.description: Provision of entertainment amenities such as movie theaters, bowling centers, arcades, live entertainment lounges, and meeting/convention spaces at resort properties. These services require physical venues, event management, and staff.

products.name: Native American Casino Development and Management Services
products.description: Development and management of gaming and entertainment facilities for Native American tribes, including project development, construction oversight, and ongoing casino management. This service is delivered through consulting, project management, and operational expertise, and is governed by regulatory agreements.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of commercial and industrial buildings on company-owned land parcels to third-party tenants. This business line involves property ownership, leasing agreements, and property management.

products.name: Metal Cutting Tools and Systems
products.description: Standard and custom metal cutting tools and systems, including milling, turning, hole making, threading, and toolmaking solutions, manufactured using advanced materials and processes and delivered through direct sales, distributors, and digital channels.

products.name: Wear-Resistant Components and Solutions
products.description: Engineered tungsten carbide and ceramic components, including compacts, nozzles, frac seats, rod blanks, and custom parts, designed for extreme wear applications in industries such as oil and gas, mining, and general engineering, produced using advanced manufacturing and material science.

products.name: Earth Cutting Tools and Systems
products.description: Earth cutting tools and systems, such as those used in underground mining, trenching, foundation drilling, and road milling, manufactured from tungsten carbide and ceramics for equipment-intensive operations.

products.name: Advanced Metallurgical Powders
products.description: Tungsten carbide and other metallurgical powders for use in oil and gas, aerospace, and process industries, produced through specialized powder metallurgy processes and supplied to industrial customers.

products.name: Ceramic Components for Industrial Applications
products.description: Ceramic components, including those used for metallization of films and papers in the packaging industry, produced using advanced ceramic manufacturing techniques.

products.name: Electronic Test and Measurement Instruments
products.description: A broad range of hardware platforms, including spectrum and signal analyzers, network analyzers, power analyzers, protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, signal generators, power supplies, network test products, and network visibility products. These are physically manufactured instruments used for precise measurement, control, and analysis of electrical and information signals across various industries.

products.name: Electronic Design and Test Software Solutions
products.description: Software products and platforms for instrument control, application-specific measurement, simulation, emulation, test automation, data management, and analytics. Delivered digitally, these solutions integrate with Keysight hardware or operate standalone to accelerate R&D, design, and validation workflows.

products.name: Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) and Simulation Software
products.description: Standalone and integrated CAE software for virtual prototyping, simulation, and design of electronic systems, including solutions acquired from ESI Group, Synopsys OSG, and Ansys PowerArtist. Delivered digitally, these tools support R&D and product development in electronics, semiconductors, and related fields.

products.name: Network Test and Assurance Solutions
products.description: Systems and software for debugging, validating, characterizing, and assuring performance of communication networks and network components, including wireless and wireline domains. These solutions are delivered as integrated hardware-software systems and are used by network operators, equipment manufacturers, and service providers.

products.name: Network Visibility and Security Solutions
products.description: Products and solutions providing data insight, monitoring, and cybersecurity testing for network traffic, applications, and users. Delivered as hardware, software, or integrated systems, these offerings ensure secure and efficient network operation and compliance.

products.name: Professional and Product Support Services
products.description: A global portfolio of services including product support (repair, calibration), technical and application support (KeysightCare), and professional services (installation, training, engineering). Delivered by trained engineers and technicians on-site or remotely, these services enhance customer productivity and solution adoption.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Origination and servicing of loans including residential mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, commercial real estate and multifamily loans, construction and land development loans, commercial business loans, consumer loans, manufactured home loans, and government/municipal loans. These are delivered through in-person and digital channels, require financial capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a broad selection of deposit accounts to retail and commercial customers, including non-interest bearing and interest bearing demand accounts, savings accounts, money market deposit accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. These are delivered through branch locations and digital banking, and require regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provision of wealth management services including estate and retirement planning, guardianships, land trusts, profit sharing and 401(k) retirement plans, IRA and Keogh accounts, investment agency accounts, and acting as personal representative or trustee for estates and trusts. Delivered by specialized staff and requiring fiduciary expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment of excess cash and management of an investment portfolio including U.S. government agency securities, mortgage-backed securities, collateralized mortgage obligations, municipal securities, and treasury securities. These are managed for liquidity and earnings, requiring financial expertise and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Insurance and Annuity Products
products.description: Provision of insurance and annuity investment products to wealth management customers, delivered through a wholly owned subsidiary and requiring licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Undergraduate and Graduate Degree Programs
products.description: Comprehensive undergraduate and graduate degree programs delivered through campus-based, online, and hybrid modalities, primarily in Mexico and Peru. Programs are physically delivered at over 50 campuses and via digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure, faculty, and technology systems.

products.name: STEM and Business Degree Programs
products.description: Specialized degree programs in science, technology, engineering, math (STEM), and business disciplines, delivered through campus-based, online, and hybrid formats. These programs are designed with applied, professional-oriented content and require both physical and digital educational infrastructure.

products.name: Medical and Health Sciences Degree Programs
products.description: Degree programs in medicine and health sciences, including medical and dental schools, delivered through campus-based and hybrid modalities. These programs require specialized, regulated facilities and faculty, and are subject to rigorous accreditation standards.

products.name: Technical and Vocational Education Programs
products.description: Technical and vocational education programs, including professional technical degrees and technical bachelor degrees, delivered through specialized institutes and colleges in Peru. These programs are offered both in-person and online, requiring regulated infrastructure and practical training facilities.

products.name: Online and Hybrid Education Programs
products.description: Fully online and hybrid (blended) education programs for undergraduate, graduate, and technical degrees, leveraging digital platforms and learning management systems. These programs are designed for both traditional and non-traditional students, providing flexible access to education.

products.name: Commercial Roofing Systems
products.description: Manufactured and supplied high-performance, single-ply roofing solutions (EPDM, TPO, PVC), polyiso insulation, architectural metal, and roof garden systems, primarily for commercial construction. Delivered through physical manufacturing and distributed via authorized sales representatives and distributors.

products.name: Building Envelope Weatherproofing and Moisture Protection Products
products.description: Provides waterproofing and moisture protection products, protective roofing underlayments, integrated air and vapor barriers, spray polyurethane foam and coating systems, and block-molded expanded polystyrene insulation for both commercial and residential buildings. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail and distribution outlets.

products.name: Digital Banking Platform
products.description: A digital-first platform providing access to FDIC-insured checking and savings accounts, debit and credit cards, and a suite of financial tools, all delivered via a mobile application and supported by proprietary technology infrastructure.

products.name: Checking Accounts and Debit Cards
products.description: Full-featured, FDIC-insured checking accounts with no monthly fees or minimum balances, linked to Chime-branded Visa debit cards, accessible via a nationwide ATM and cash deposit network.

products.name: High Yield Savings Accounts
products.description: FDIC-insured high yield savings accounts with competitive interest rates, no minimum balances, and automatic savings features, accessible through the mobile app.

products.name: Short-Term Liquidity Products
products.description: A suite of digital products providing members with short-term liquidity, including fee-free overdraft (SpotMe), early paycheck access (Get Paid Early, MyPay), and instant installment loans, all managed through the app.

products.name: Secured Credit Cards and Credit Building Tools
products.description: Secured Visa credit cards (Chime Card and Credit Builder) designed to help members build credit without fees or interest, complemented by FICO score tracking and credit progress alerts.

products.name: Peer-to-Peer Payments
products.description: Instant, secure peer-to-peer payments (Pay Anyone) allowing members to send money from their Chime accounts to anyone, regardless of whether the recipient uses Chime.

products.name: Employer-Provided Financial Wellness Solutions (Chime Enterprise)
products.description: A suite of financial services and employee benefits tools (Chime Workplace), including early wage access (MyPay), offered to employees through partnerships with employers and human capital management platforms.

products.name: Tax Filing Services
products.description: Free state and federal tax filing services, integrated into the mobile app through a partnership with a registered tax e-file provider, enabling early refund access via direct deposit.

products.name: Cashback and Rewards Offers
products.description: Cashback deals and exclusive offers (Chime Deals) at thousands of retailers, available to members through the app, with enhanced rewards for premium members.

products.name: Azenosertib (WEE1 Inhibitor)
products.description: An investigational, oral, small molecule WEE1 inhibitor developed for the treatment of ovarian cancer and other solid tumors. It is produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing by third-party contract manufacturing organizations and delivered as an oral therapeutic, currently in clinical trials for various cancer indications.

products.name: Companion Diagnostic Test for Cyclin E1 Protein
products.description: A proprietary immunohistochemistry (IHC)-based diagnostic test designed to identify patients with PROC that overexpress the Cyclin E1 protein. Developed in partnership with a diagnostic company, it is used to select patients for azenosertib therapy and is manufactured and validated for clinical trial and potential commercial use.

products.name: Glaucoma Laser Treatment Systems
products.description: Laser systems and associated single-use probes for the treatment of glaucoma, including the Cyclo G6 laser system with MicroPulse technology, PASCAL laser system for pattern scanning laser trabeculoplasty, and single-use probes such as MicroPulse P3, G-Probe, and G-Probe Illuminate. These products require physical manufacturing, regulatory clearance, and are delivered as capital equipment and consumables to ophthalmologists.

products.name: Medical Retina Laser Treatment Systems
products.description: Laser systems and delivery devices for the treatment of retinal diseases, including the IQ 532 and IQ 577 laser systems with MicroPulse technology, and the PASCAL system with Endpoint Management and pattern scanning capabilities. These are manufactured medical devices used in clinics and hospitals for non-incisional laser therapy of retinal disorders.

products.name: Surgical Retina Laser Treatment Systems
products.description: Laser systems and single-use EndoProbe handpieces for use in surgical procedures such as vitrectomy to treat proliferative diabetic retinopathy, macular holes, retinal tears, and detachments. These products are physically manufactured and used in operating rooms and surgical centers.

products.name: Laser System Consumables and Delivery Devices
products.description: Single-use laser probes (such as MicroPulse P3, G-Probe, G-Probe Illuminate, and EndoProbe) and optical-mechanical delivery devices (such as slit lamp adapters, indirect ophthalmoscopes, and TxCell scanning systems) that are used with IRIDEX laser consoles for specific ophthalmic procedures. These are manufactured products sold as recurring revenue items to customers using IRIDEX laser systems.

products.name: Laser System Service and Extended Service Contracts
products.description: Repair, maintenance, and extended service contracts for IRIDEX laser systems, providing technical support and depot service to customers. This service is delivered by in-house technical staff and is a recurring revenue stream.

products.name: Offshore Contract Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of contract drilling services for oil and gas wells using a global fleet of mobile offshore drilling units, including floaters (drillships and semisubmersibles) and jackup rigs. Services are delivered under individual contracts, typically on a dayrate basis, and require significant physical assets, technical expertise, and in-person labor in regulated environments.

products.name: SI Joint Fusion Systems
products.description: A portfolio of minimally invasive surgical systems, including The Catamaran System and The SImmetry+ System, designed to treat sacroiliac (SI) joint disorders by providing fixation and promoting biological fusion using proprietary titanium implants, specialized instruments, and bone grafting techniques. These systems are manufactured by contract manufacturers and delivered to healthcare facilities for use in primary, revision, and adjunct SI joint fusion procedures.

products.name: Engineered Wood Siding Products
products.description: Manufactured engineered wood siding, trim, soffit, and fascia products, offered both primed and pre-finished, for use in new home construction, repair and remodeling, and outdoor structures. Production involves wood composite manufacturing, overlays, chemical treatments, and paint finishing at company-owned facilities.

products.name: Oriented Strand Board (OSB) Structural Panels
products.description: Manufactures and distributes OSB structural panel products, including commodity OSB and value-added engineered panels with features such as fire resistance, moisture protection, and enhanced strength, used in roof decking, wall sheathing, and sub-flooring. Production is based on converting sustainably harvested wood fiber at company facilities.

products.name: Specialty OSB Building Solutions
products.description: Produces and sells specialty OSB-based building solutions under the LP Structural Solutions brand, including fire-rated sheathing, air and water barriers, radiant barriers, and premium sub-flooring, engineered for specific performance attributes. These are manufactured at company plants using advanced wood composite technologies.

products.name: South American Building Products
products.description: Manufactures and distributes OSB structural panels and siding products tailored for the South American and certain export markets, produced at regional facilities using similar engineered wood processes as North American operations.

products.name: Mobile Computing Devices
products.description: Rugged and enterprise-grade mobile computers, including handhelds, wearables, vehicle-mounted computers, tablets, and kiosks, designed and manufactured for specialized enterprise applications and delivered as physical devices with supporting software and accessories.

products.name: Barcode and Card Printing Solutions
products.description: Thermal printers and dye-sublimation card printers for on-demand production of labels, wristbands, tickets, receipts, and plastic cards, including RFID-enabled printers, delivered as physical hardware with supporting firmware and accessories.

products.name: Barcode Scanners and Data Capture Devices
products.description: Handheld, fixed, and embedded barcode scanners and imagers, including fixed industrial scanners, designed and manufactured for data capture in various industries, delivered as physical devices with supporting software and accessories.

products.name: RFID and Real-Time Location Systems (RTLS)
products.description: Hardware and software solutions for RFID and RTLS, including fixed readers, RFID-enabled mobile computers, RFID sleds, tags, sensors, and middleware, enabling real-time tracking and location of assets, delivered as integrated systems.

products.name: Workflow Optimization and Analytics Software
products.description: Cloud-based and on-device software solutions for workflow management, task execution, workforce management, demand sensing, price optimization, and prescriptive analytics, delivered as software subscriptions and managed services.

products.name: Self-Service and Interactive Touchscreen Solutions
products.description: Self-serve kiosks, interactive touchscreen displays, and point-of-sale solutions for customer-facing workflows, including payment and self-checkout, delivered as physical devices with integrated software.

products.name: Machine Vision Systems
products.description: Industrial machine vision cameras, smart cameras, 3D sensors, vision controllers, and AI-enabled software for automated inspection, data capture, and quality control in manufacturing and logistics, delivered as hardware and software solutions.

products.name: Supplies and Consumables
products.description: Stock and custom thermal labels, wristbands, receipts, ribbons, plastic cards, RFID tags, and temperature-monitoring labels, produced and sold for use with company printers and tracking solutions, delivered as physical consumables.

products.name: Professional, Managed, and Maintenance Services
products.description: A comprehensive suite of services including maintenance, technical support, repair, managed and professional services, device management, and deployment support, delivered directly or through partners, often as cloud-based subscriptions.

products.name: Ocean Freight Transportation Services
products.description: Provides ocean freight transportation of containerized and roll-on/roll-off cargo between the U.S. West Coast and Hawaii, Alaska, Guam, Micronesia, Japan, China, and South Pacific islands using a fleet of owned and chartered vessels and barges. Services include both domestic Jones Act trades and international routes, with regular, scheduled sailings and integrated inter-island barge networks.

products.name: Terminal and Stevedoring Services
products.description: Offers terminal operations, stevedoring, refrigerated cargo handling, inland transportation, container equipment maintenance, and other terminal-related services at company-operated and joint-venture terminals in Hawaii, Alaska, and the U.S. West Coast, as well as through third-party arrangements at other ports.

products.name: Transportation Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides multimodal transportation brokerage, including domestic and international rail intermodal, long-haul and regional highway trucking, specialized hauling, flat-bed and project services, less-than-truckload, and expedited freight services, leveraging third-party carrier relationships and owned intermodal containers.

products.name: Freight Forwarding Services
products.description: Aggregates, consolidates, and forwards less-than-container load (LCL) and full container load shipments, primarily to Alaska and other markets, using cross-dock facilities and a network of trucking and ocean carrier partners.

products.name: Warehousing and Distribution Services
products.description: Operates warehouses providing storage, trans-loading, value-added packaging, and distribution services in select U.S. locations, supporting customer supply chains with physical handling and inventory management.

products.name: Supply Chain Management Services
products.description: Delivers integrated supply chain management solutions including purchase order management, booking, customs brokerage, and non-vessel operating common carrier (NVOCC) freight forwarding, with operations in North America, China, and other Asian countries.

products.name: Medical Diagnostic Test Kits
products.description: A broad range of in vitro diagnostic test kits manufactured and marketed for use in clinical laboratories and point-of-care settings, including tests for blood, urine, nasal, and fecal samples to detect diseases, food intolerances, bacteria, hormones, antibodies, and antigens. These products are physically manufactured, require regulatory clearance, and are distributed globally.

products.name: Rapid Point-of-Care and Home Diagnostic Tests
products.description: Rapid diagnostic tests designed for use at home or in physicians’ offices, providing results in minutes with limited or no instrumentation. These tests are manufactured and distributed for both over-the-counter and professional use, focusing on ease of use and early disease detection.

products.name: inFoods® IBS Diagnostic-Guided Therapy Product
products.description: A patented diagnostic-guided therapy product based on the inFoods® technology platform, utilizing a blood test to identify patient-specific foods that trigger IBS symptoms. The product is manufactured and marketed to gastroenterology physician groups and is supported by clinical studies and insurance reimbursement efforts.

products.name: hp+detect™ H. pylori Diagnostic Test
products.description: A proprietary diagnostic test for detecting Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection and monitoring treatment, cleared by the FDA and marketed to laboratories and physicians. The test is manufactured in-house and positioned for commercial adoption in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: EZ Detect Colon Disease Home Test
products.description: A proprietary home test product for the detection of colon disease, designed for consumer use without laboratory equipment. The product is manufactured and marketed directly to consumers and distributors.

products.name: Aware Breast Self-Exam Product
products.description: A proprietary product designed to assist individuals in performing breast self-examinations at home. The product is manufactured and marketed for consumer use as a preventive health tool.

products.name: Contract Research and Development and Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Services provided to third-party companies involving contract research, product development, and manufacturing of diagnostic products, leveraging the company’s technical expertise and manufacturing facilities. These services are performed under limited license agreements and are not the primary revenue driver.

products.name: Mobile EV Charging Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a suite of mobile electric vehicle charging products, including truck-mounted, trailer-mounted, and stationary solutions, delivered as physical equipment and deployed at customer sites or events.

products.name: Power Generation Equipment
products.description: Distributes new and refurbished power generation equipment, including engine-generator sets and uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, sourced from multiple manufacturers and installed by licensed technicians at customer facilities.

products.name: Service and Maintenance for Power Systems
